title: Pull Strings (+CHA)
description:
When you influence an NPC to do what you want, choose an approach below and roll+cha:
- If you *deceive them with false words or actions*, they might later seek the truth or learn a secret about you
- If you *persuade them openly and honestly*, they might ask for a promise and/or payment, or only partly follow through
- If you *threaten their safety or interests*, they might escalate the conflict now, or escape or betray you later

outcomes.text: They'll do it as best as they can.
They'll try, but the GM will add a complication based on your approach.
They make things worse; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Advancements
description: When you **Level Up**, increase your *HP* by 1 (max +10) and choose one of the following:
pick: Gain a Path from your Class
+1 to any stat (max +2)
+1 to any stat (max +2)
Reveal a Struggle
Take another Move from a Class Path
Take another Move from a Class Path
Take another Move from a Class Path
Take another Move from a Class Path

submoves.title: From Level 5 onwards, you can choose from the following:
pick: Gain a Path from your Class
+1 to any Stat (max +2)
*Multiclass* - Gain a Path from another Class
Obtain a *magic item* - choose from those available or work with your GM to create one
Take another Move from a Class Path
Take another Move from a Class Path
Take another Move from a Class Path
Take another Move from a Class Path
Take another Move from another Class Path
Take another Move from another Class Path
Take another Move from another Class Path
Take another Move from another Class Path

submoves.title: From Level 10 onwards, you can choose from the following:
pick: +1 to any stat (max +3)
*Multiclass* - Gain a Path from another Class
Obtain an *Artifact* - Choose from those available or work with your GM to create one
Take an additional Move from another Class Path
Take an additional Move from another Class Path
Take an additional Move from another Class Path
Take an additional Move from another Class Path

title: Aid A PC
description:
While you **help another PC**, they have **Advantage** on their rolls. Before the helped PC rolls, you must either: 

- erase 1 Depth with them 

 - expose yourself to their same risks and consequences

 - or mark a Condition

title: Cast a Spell (+Variable)
description: When you **invoke magic you can use**, say what you want to happen and roll+the corresponding Stat (see your Class or Paths) with a penalty equal to the spell's **MAG** (GM's call).

outcomes.text: The spell is successfully cast.
It goes off but choose one:
bullets: A unique option depending on the source of your magic (see your Class or Paths)
The effort is tiresome; mark Conditions equal to the spell's mag
There's a twist; the GM will add an "and" or "but" to its effect

outcomes.text: Something goes terribly wrong; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

submoves.title: Spell Magnitude
submoves.description: Magnitude (mag) represents the scale and power of a spell. The GM has the final say on a spell's mag, but these guidelines below should help:

outcomes.text: Example effects include: shoot a magical dart (1d6 dmg); summon or charm an ordinary being; put someone to magical sleep; slow down a fall
Example effects include: shoot an acid arrow (1d8 dmg); read someone's thoughts; turn someone invisible until they trigger a Move; float up to a #near distance

Example effects include: an explosive fireball (1d10 dmg); communicate with a ghost or spirit; fabricate a finished mundane item instantly from a pile of raw materials; turn yourself and your equipment into a cloud of smoke

Example effects include: vomit a cloud of poison that damages anyone any time they breath the gas (1d12 dmg); create a door to another dimension; polymorph someone into another natural creature of their same size or smaller; lift a creature or object of up to 1,000 pounds and move it to a #near location and hold it in place

Example effects include: utter a forbidden power word that kills anyone weaker than you or inflicts (1d8+1d6 dmg) if they're stronger; summon or paralyze a monstrous creature; make a single wish (and you can't wish for more wishes); teleport yourself and allies to any location on the same dimension

title: Defy Danger (+Variable)
description:
When you **contend with a risk, threat, or obstacle** - and no other move fits better - describe how you do it, then the GM chooses one:
- +str if you power through, physically endure, or break it
- +dex if you dodge, outpace, or target it precisely
- +int if you analyze, notice, or outsmart it
- +wis if you scrutinize, empathize with, or resolutely resist it
- +cha if you charm, trick, impress, or provoke it

outcomes.text: You overcome it flawlessly.
You prevail over it, but choose one below:
bullets: Doing so draws unwanted attention or escalates the situation; the GM will say how after you choose this option
The effort drains or rattles you; mark a condition
You sacrifice something to do it; say what it is. The GM may ask for more

outcomes.text: Your efforts are thwarted or go terribly wrong; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Sense Motive (+WIS)
description: When you **scrutinize someone throughout a conversation**, roll+wis.

outcomes.text: You can ask their player two questions during the conversation (if they're an NPC, the GM answers).
Ask them only one.
If studying an NPC, then you're discovered or interrupted; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move. If studying a PC, then they ask you a question instead.

submoves.title: Questions
submoves.description:
Questions can be about a character's thoughts, feelings, or motivations. All answers must be truthful, even if the character(s) might not be.

Some example questions include:
- Are you lying about...?
- How might I get you to ...?
- How do you feel about ...?
- What do you desire most?

outcomes.text: You remain completely undetected.
You do it, but the GM chooses one:
bullets: Someone grows suspicious; you have Disavantage to Sneak Past until that changes
You did it by the skin of your teeth; mark a condition
You don't have long; act now before the window of opportunity closes

outcomes.text: You're spotted or expected; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Spout Lore (+Questions)
description:
When you **rack your brain for information about a specific subject**, ask the GM one question about it, answer the questions below, then roll with +1 for each "Yes":
- Do you have access to a book or equivalent record about this subject?
- Is this subject related to your Origins?
- Is this subject relevant to your Struggle?

outcomes.text: The GM answers generously, and you or an ally also gain **Advantage** the first time someone acts on the answer.
The GM just answers generously.
The GM answers with danger or an unwelcome truth; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Trade Blows (+STR or +DEX)
description: When you **engage a foe in battle**, roll+str in melee or +dex at range (or with *precise* weapons), then inflict your dmg and suffer theirs.

outcomes.text: Choose one:
bullets: An ally gets a fleeting opportunity
You inflict max dmg
You suffer min dmg

outcomes.text: Choose one of these instead:
bullets: Something upsets or provokes you; mark a condition
You grant the opponent a fleeting opportunity
You lose or break something. Choose what; the GM may ask for more

outcomes.text: You inflict min dmg or suffer max dmg (your call); mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

title: Unearth Secrets (+INT)
description: When you **investigate a mysterious situation or location**, ask the GM, "Are there any secrets to discover here?" If "Yes", roll+int. No matter what you roll, you always discover something; the GM will tell you what.

outcomes.text: Your discovery is clear and significant.
Choose one from below:
bullets: It is an important clue, but not a clear answer
The discovery puts you at risk; the GM will say how after you choose this option
The discovery rattles you; mark a condition

outcomes.text: The discovery is dangerous; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.
Once per session, after you **offer comfort or support to another PC**, answer the following questions
bullets: Did you explore, change, or reaffirm a Relationship or Bond?
Did they open up to you in return?
Did either of you reveal something new about your Struggle?

outcomes.text: For each "Yes", the comforted can choose (they can choose an option more than once).
bullets: Clear a marked Condition
Gain 1 Depth to their Relationship with the comforter
Or have the comforter clear a marked Condition.

title: End the Session
description: When you **reach the end of a session**, answer the following questions as a group

outcomes.text: For each "Yes", everyone marks XP
bullets: Did anyone add Depth to their Relationship(s)?
Did we defeat a dangerous threat, visit a new location, and/or find a memorable treasure?
Did we learn something new and important about the world or NPCs?

title: Face Death
description:
When you **reach 0 HP**, you're Helpless until you recover HP or the Scene ends. While Helpless, if you lose any HP, you die. When you recover any HP, lock one of your Conditions and you're no longer Helpless.

When you take decisive action while Helpless, choose one before resolving the action:

outcomes.text: You push past the pain; recover half your max HP (rounded down) then resolve your action.
The GM says what part of you won't survive; accept the loss and recover 1 HP, or hold on to it and die after acting.
You're too hurt to act and will die before this Scene ends; you say when. What are your last words?

submoves.title: Go Out in a Blaze of Glory
submoves.description: Briefly take control of the Scene, describe one last deed you accomplish, then die.

title: Level Up
description: When you **mark the last XP on your PC's Experience track**, clear the track, add 1 to your Level and current+maximum HP (up to +10), and gain one Advancement available to your new Level (or lower).

title: Make Camp
description:
Once per session, when you **spend a few hours resting** (even while adventuring), describe cooperatively what each PC is up to. Things in the world worsen each time you **Make Camp**.

When you **finish Making Camp**, each PC regains half their lost HP (rounded down) and clears one marked Condition.

title: Perform a Ritual
description:
When you **draw on a font of magical power** (object, person, or place) to create an effect, tell the GM what you're trying to achieve. The GM will ask for requirements equal to the effect's mag (min. 1) from the following (filling in the blanks or making choices when needed):
- First you must ...
- It's going to take days/weeks/months
- It will require ...
- The effect will be unreliable or limited
- You and your allies will risk ...
- You'll need help from ...
- You'll have to destroy ... to do it

Once all requirements are fulfilled, the ritual is complete and the magical effect takes place.

title: Reach Your Limit
description:
When you **mark your last Condition**, clear all your marked Conditions then choose and act out one of the following outbursts:
- **Angry** — Lash out at your allies or break something important
- **Distracted** — Wander off alone or miss something relevant
- **Exhausted** — Collapse or give up when it matters
- **Frightened** — Hide or flee from danger
- **Insecure** — Overcompensate or harshly criticize someone

After the outburst, lock the chosen Condition.

title: Undertake a Perilous Journey
description:
When you **travel through hostile territory**, choose a destination, a leader, and a method of travel:
- **Quickly, risking it all.** -1 to the roll, everyone marks a Condition; you arrive earlier than expected
- **Regular pace.** +1 to the roll, only the leader marks a Condition; you arrive when expected
- **Slow & careful.** +2 to the roll; you arrive later than expected

Then the leader rolls with the corresponding modifier.

outcomes.text: You arrive with a boon; the GM will tell you what.
You'll get there but choose one:
bullets: Someone's following you; let them, or everyone marks a Condition to lose them
Something unpleasant awaits at your destination
You encounter a danger along the way, but you have the drop on them

outcomes.text: A danger surprises you; everyone marks 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.
When you **spend a few days resting in a safe place**, you may do as many as you'd like of the following:
bullets: **Carouse.** Spend 1 Treasure so all PCs can recover back to max HP
**Reconnect.** Spend 1 Treasure to clear a locked Condition or gain 1 Depth with another PC
**Resupply.** Spend 1 Treasure to refresh all uses on a PC's non-magic items
**Shop.** Spend 1 Treasure to repair equipment, purchase items, or enlist services; you spend 1 Treasure per good/service
**Train.** Once per Downtime each PC can spend 1 Treasure to mark XP

outcomes.text: When **two PCs have 3 Depth with the each other**, clear both tracks and the Relationships, then choose one:
bullets: **Establish a new Bond.** Choose a Bond; write it on both character sheets in place of the Relationships. If you shared another Bond, erase it; both of you mark 1 XP for each Bond Advanced Move it had unlocked
**Reinforce an existing Bond.** Unlock a new Bond Advanced Move from it

**"How are you really feeling?"** Ask each other at least one question about your character's thoughts, feelings, or motivations. If both answer truthfully, each marks 1 XP or clears 1 locked Condition

title: Reveal Your Struggle
description: When you **Make Camp** with a locked Condition, or when you **Level Up**, you may choose to confess a new, terrible truth about your PC's Struggle. If you do, reveal a new **Struggle** or add a new detail to an already revealed one (and clear the locked Condition if any).

outcomes.text: You can only have one revealed Struggle at a time. When your revealed Struggle is resolved, **Level Up** (keeping marked XP), erase the Struggle, and lose both its Benefits (+) and Drawbacks (-). Clear the Advancement box if marked; you can choose a new Struggle in the future.
